newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996/97 motorcycle exports up 2.1% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996/97 motorcycle exports up 2.1% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle exports rose 2.1 percent to 1,362,707 units in the year to March 1997, compared with the year earlier period, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said on Monday.
But in dollar terms, Japan's exports of assembled motorcycles and motorcycle components fell 4.9 percent from a year earlier to $6.03 billion in 1996/97.

Motorcycle exports to Europe rose 28.9 percent from a year earlier to 468,742 in 1996/97. But exports to Asia fell 13.6 percent from a year earlier to 389,262 in 1996/97, and exports to the United States declined 9.7 percent to 228,511.

Japan's motorcycle exports rose 2.9 percent in March from a year earlier to 122,678. But in value terms, March exports fell 6.2 percent from a year earlier to $526.29 million.
